name: Ironclad Rivet Open-Source AI Agent IDE
free_limit: MIT-licensed desktop visual IDE and TypeScript runtime for designing, debugging and running AI-agent/prompt-chain graphs locally; no Rivet software seat or workflow usage charge.
watch_out: LLM calls, embeddings, speech APIs, remote execution and storage are not included and may require paid third-party API keys. This is the Ironclad desktop IDE, not the separate Rivet Actors orchestration product.
